title: diag.1: lichen_diag core module — ring buffer, CoAP /diag, UART output
description: Create lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/lichen_diag.c. Ring buffer of diagnostic events (struct: timestamp, subsystem enum, event code, u32 detail, 32-byte message). lichen_diag_report() API callable from any subsystem. CoAP GET /diag returns CBOR array of recent events. UART prints human-readable on each event. Kconfig CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG, default y. ~150 lines.
close_reason: Diag core module landed per the bead spec: lichen/subsys/lichen/diag/lichen_diag.c + include/lichen/diag.h + Kconfig + CMake wiring. (1) Ring buffer of lichen_diag_event (timestamp_ms u64 monotonic, subsystem enum, event_code u16, detail u32, message[33] NUL-terminated) with CONFIG_LICHEN_DIAG_CAPACITY (default 32, range 4-256); lichen_diag_report() appends (oldest overwritten when full) and prints human-readable over the console (printk, subsystem-names table); lichen_diag_get(i) copies oldest-first via base=(head+cap-count)%cap — reviewer-verified arithmetic; lichen_diag_count() retained count; lichen_diag_init() idempotent. (2) GET /diag CoAP resource (COAP_RESOURCE_DEFINE, matches coap_dtn.c pattern) returns a CBOR array of 5-field maps {ts, sub, code, detail} via zcbor (backtrack 2, list + nested maps); internal-error fallback with empty body on encode failure. (3) Kconfig: LICHEN_DIAG depends on LICHEN_COAP_SERVER default y; LICHEN_DIAG_CAPACITY gated. (4) Registered in lichen/subsys/lichen/{CMakeLists.txt,Kconfig} (add_subdirectory_ifdef + rsource). Verification: cppcheck gate exit 0 on the diag dir; narrow Kimi K3 review PASS (ring oldest-base arithmetic traced 33-reports case, init-guard and subsystem-bounds placement confirmed); zcbor_uint16_put does not exist in the workspace zcbor (reviewer flag confirmed by grep) — replaced with zcbor_uint32_put before commit. This module unblocks the 10 detector children (ldzz.2-.11) which call lichen_diag_report().
